en: I knew you would come. I had a vision of your arrival, three years ago.
Psychic power has been mine since I was a child. I don't enjoy battling, but if you insist...
Very well. I'll show you my powers!
This loss... It shocks me. But I won't deny it. Take the Marsh Badge.
{player} received the Marsh Badge from Sabrina!
With the Marsh Badge, your Pokémon can use Rock Smash outside of battle.
And please take this TM. Its move suits someone of strong mind.
TM04 is Calm Mind. It quiets the mind, raising both Special Attack and Special Defense.
I foresaw your victory, and still I fought. Perhaps the future isn't fixed after all.
Yo, champ in the making! Sabrina's Psychic Pokémon are tough. Bug and Ghost moves hit them hard.
The pads on the floor warp you between rooms. Find the right ones and you'll reach her!
You beat Sabrina! I never would've predicted that. Ha!
Saffron City Pokémon Gym. Leader: Sabrina. Winning trainers: {rival}.
Saffron City Pokémon Gym. Leader: Sabrina. Winning trainers: {rival}, {player}.
